note: Adapted from the original species-level description of Ahmad (1965), in English; the original describes only the queen and the soldier, with no alate or worker morphology entered under this species, and measurements are in mm (Table 45 for the two queens, Table 46 for the ten soldiers). Type locality Makham, Thailand, collected from a dome-shaped nest on the ground on 1962-03-27. The soldier is closest to padangensis, differing in the stronger apical hook of the left mandible, the anterolateral corners without tubercles, antennal segment 2 shorter than segment 3, and the longer and wider head.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: head dark brown, postclypeus slightly paler, labrum cream-white, antennae brown, pronotum slightly paler than the head. Head densely covered with short hairs and with scattered long setae, the postclypeus slightly more sparsely hairy, the labrum with a few hairs, the pronotum with many short hairs and fewer scattered setae. Head nearly round, fontanelle indistinct. Compound eyes round and projecting, one quarter of their short diameter from the lower margin of the head; ocelli rather distinct, broadly oval, one short diameter from the compound eye; postclypeus twice as wide as long, the median line weak. Labrum broadly dome-shaped. Antennae incomplete, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, about twice as wide as long; anterior margin straight, not concave, the sides convex, widest slightly beyond the middle, the posterior margin very distinctly concave.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, the anterolateral corners brownish; labrum pale yellow; left mandible dark brown, right mandible light reddish brown; antennae yellow with brown; thorax, abdomen and legs cream-white. Head with a few scattered setae, the centre of the labral concavity with 3 short hairs, the pronotum sparsely hairy. Head long, nearly rectangular, the sides slightly convex, the anterolateral corners projecting as distinct tuberculate processes; fontanelle small and round; frons gradually sloping; coronal suture distinct, its posterior end slightly beyond the middle. Anterior margin of the labrum deeply and widely concave, the anterolateral corners extended into long pointed processes, and at the base of each anterolateral process another small but distinct process. Mandibles asymmetrical: the left mandible curved in the middle, the inner margin shallowly concave before the bend, the tip beaked and incurved, with 1 small tooth below the tip; the right mandible broad and blade-like, the sides slightly curved, the anterior margin shallowly concave. Postmentum elongate, 3—4 times as long as its greatest width, the anterior width almost twice the waist width. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2 and equal to segment 4. Pronotum saddle-shaped, twice as wide as long; the anterior margin with a notch in the middle, the posterior margin convex and not concave, the lateral lobes distinct, narrow and rounded.
